name: Hero + Features + CTA
sectionOrder: Hero with headline/image > Value prop > Key features (3-5) > CTA section > Footer
primaryCTA: Hero (sticky) + Bottom

name: Hero + Testimonials + CTA
sectionOrder: Hero > Problem statement > Solution overview > Testimonials carousel > CTA
primaryCTA: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials

name: Product Demo + Features
sectionOrder: Hero > Product video/mockup (center) > Feature breakdown per section > Comparison (optional) > CTA
primaryCTA: Video center + CTA right/bottom

name: Minimal Single Column
sectionOrder: Hero headline > Short description > Benefit bullets (3 max) > CTA > Footer
primaryCTA: Center, large CTA button

name: Funnel (3-Step Conversion)
sectionOrder: Hero > Step 1 (problem) > Step 2 (solution) > Step 3 (action) > CTA progression
primaryCTA: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA

name: Comparison Table + CTA
sectionOrder: Hero > Problem intro > Comparison table (product vs competitors) > Pricing (optional) > CTA
primaryCTA: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table

name: Lead Magnet + Form
sectionOrder: Hero (benefit headline) > Lead magnet preview (ebook cover, checklist, etc) > Form (minimal fields) > CTA submit
primaryCTA: Form CTA: Submit button

name: Pricing Page + CTA
sectionOrder: Hero (pricing headline) > Price comparison cards > Feature comparison table > FAQ section > Final CTA
primaryCTA: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav

name: Video-First Hero
sectionOrder: Hero with video background > Key features overlay > Benefits section > CTA
primaryCTA: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section

name: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling
sectionOrder: Intro hook > Chapter 1 (problem) > Chapter 2 (journey) > Chapter 3 (solution) > Climax CTA
primaryCTA: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA

name: AI Personalization Landing
sectionOrder: Dynamic hero (personalized) > Relevant features > Tailored testimonials > Smart CTA
primaryCTA: Context-aware placement based on user segment

name: Waitlist/Coming Soon
sectionOrder: Hero with countdown > Product teaser/preview > Email capture form > Social proof (waitlist count)
primaryCTA: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll

name: Comparison Table Focus
sectionOrder: Hero (problem statement) > Comparison matrix (you vs competitors) > Feature deep-dive > Winner CTA
primaryCTA: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom

name: Pricing-Focused Landing
sectionOrder: Hero (value proposition) > Pricing cards (3 tiers) > Feature comparison > FAQ > Final CTA
primaryCTA: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom

name: App Store Style Landing
sectionOrder: Hero with device mockup > Screenshots carousel > Features with icons > Reviews/ratings > Download CTAs
primaryCTA: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout

name: FAQ/Documentation Landing
sectionOrder: Hero with search bar > Popular categories > FAQ accordion > Contact/support CTA
primaryCTA: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions

name: Immersive/Interactive Experience
sectionOrder: Full-screen interactive element > Guided product tour > Key benefits revealed > CTA after completion
primaryCTA: After interaction complete + Skip option for impatient users

name: Event/Conference Landing
sectionOrder: Hero (date/location/countdown) > Speakers grid > Agenda/schedule > Sponsors > Register CTA
primaryCTA: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom

name: Product Review/Ratings Focused
sectionOrder: Hero (product + aggregate rating) > Rating breakdown > Individual reviews > Buy/CTA
primaryCTA: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews

name: Community/Forum Landing
sectionOrder: Hero (community value prop) > Popular topics/categories > Active members showcase > Join CTA
primaryCTA: Join button prominent + After member showcase

name: Before-After Transformation
sectionOrder: Hero (problem state) > Transformation slider/comparison > How it works > Results CTA
primaryCTA: After transformation reveal + Bottom

name: Marketplace / Directory
sectionOrder: Hero (Search focused) > Categories > Featured Listings > Trust/Safety > CTA (Become a host/seller)
primaryCTA: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'

name: Newsletter / Content First
sectionOrder: Hero (Value Prop + Form) > Recent Issues/Archives > Social Proof (Subscriber count) > About Author
primaryCTA: Hero inline form + Sticky header form

name: Webinar Registration
sectionOrder: Hero (Topic + Timer + Form) > What you'll learn > Speaker Bio > Urgency/Bonuses > Form (again)
primaryCTA: Hero (Right side form) + Bottom anchor

name: Enterprise Gateway
sectionOrder: Hero (Video/Mission) > Solutions by Industry > Solutions by Role > Client Logos > Contact Sales
primaryCTA: Contact Sales (Primary) + Login (Secondary)

name: Portfolio Grid
sectionOrder: Hero (Name/Role) > Project Grid (Masonry) > About/Philosophy > Contact
primaryCTA: Project Card Hover + Footer Contact

name: Horizontal Scroll Journey
sectionOrder: Intro (Vertical) > The Journey (Horizontal Track) > Detail Reveal > Vertical Footer
primaryCTA: Floating Sticky CTA or End of Horizontal Track

name: Bento Grid Showcase
sectionOrder: Hero > Bento Grid (Key Features) > Detail Cards > Tech Specs > CTA
primaryCTA: Floating Action Button or Bottom of Grid

name: Interactive 3D Configurator
sectionOrder: Hero (Configurator) > Feature Highlight (synced) > Price/Specs > Purchase
primaryCTA: Inside Configurator UI + Sticky Bottom Bar

name: AI-Driven Dynamic Landing
sectionOrder: Prompt/Input Hero > Generated Result Preview > How it Works > Value Prop
primaryCTA: Input Field (Hero) + 'Try it' Buttons

name: Feature-Rich Showcase
sectionOrder: Hero (value prop) > Feature grid/cards (4-6) > Use cases or benefits > Social proof or logos > CTA
primaryCTA: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom

name: Hero-Centric Design
sectionOrder: Full-bleed Hero (headline + visual) > Single value prop strip > Key benefit or proof > Primary CTA
primaryCTA: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA

name: Trust & Authority + Conversion
sectionOrder: Hero (mission/credibility) > Proof (logos, certs, stats) > Solution overview > Clear CTA path
primaryCTA: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav

name: Real-Time / Operations Landing
sectionOrder: Hero (product + live preview or status) > Key metrics/indicators > How it works > CTA (Start trial / Contact)
primaryCTA: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
